name: imgui
description: Dear ImGui: Bloat-free Graphical User interface for C++ with minimal dependencies

aiSummary.whatItDoes: Dear ImGui is a graphical user interface library for C++ that is designed to be lightweight and efficient, allowing developers to create tools and visualizations quickly. It is optimized for real-time applications and is portable across various platforms with minimal dependencies.
aiSummary.whyItMatters: This library is particularly valuable for game developers and those building real-time 3D applications, as it facilitates rapid prototyping and tool development without the overhead of more complex frameworks.
aiSummary.gettingStarted: To begin using Dear ImGui, simply include the core files from the repository into your project and compile them. No specific build process is required.
